name: theme-switcher
title: Theme Switcher
author: andrewhicks123
description: Light / dark / system mode plus twelve color themes, a custom hue picker and a radius picker for next-themes and shadcn/ui. Adds the provider, hook, switcher popover, customizer, swatches, mode toggle and the hue-based theme CSS.
